label: M1 the two negations are never stored into the frame (the `fst [ebp-0x18]` / `fst [ebp-0x14]` at 0x102da21c and 0x102da224 dropped). Negation is exact and the last two fields still multiply the same value, so no FIELD of the matrix changes - the only evidence is the two words in memory and the two reads that take them back. If a state where the object overlaps the frame still passes, the fields are not really reading memory

M2 the column component is HOISTED: the +0x30 field multiplies the e.x read up front for the dot instead of reading [ecx] at the point the entry's `fmul` does. This is the reading that was wrong first, and it is invisible unless a store into [eax] lands on the vector - which is what the fuzzed states that put the object at the arena's last word do
